purpose: Freeze one source-backed local GLONASS provenance-miss admission boundary after proving that the official correction graph uses local common-stream and finite-residual gates rather than a 100-percent GLONASS FCN route gate.

decision.official_admission_model: per-observation/per-frequency-field finite corrected-code gate after common-satellite intersection and in-domain interpolation
decision.native_phase111_model: per-exact-(SatelliteId,SignalType) stream and finite correction local miss mask with conservation
decision.current_native_phase126_128_model: GLONASS provenance failure aborts source-complete base model and app before Phase111 mask

candidate.scope: Change only an unaccepted GLONASS provenance row from an earlier route-global abort into an explicit local miss while preserving the existing canonical parser, source-complete operator, shared factor vector, and Phase111 exact-stream mask.

base_intersection.meaning: Only common satellites enter the base residual/interpolation path; this is not a requirement that every observed satellite or every GLONASS row be present.

frequency_stream.meaning: Correction is performed separately for each nonempty frequency field before graph construction.

interpolation.meaning: Missing stream values and times outside the finite interpolation domain do not receive an extrapolated correction; the corrected value is non-finite/NaN.

factor_gate.meaning: A missing/non-finite corrected code row is locally not added; Doppler/TDCP have independent gates.

official_fcn_caveat.meaning: The official Android conversion estimates a supported GLO frequency from raw CarrierFrequencyHz and materializes only available fields/rows. It does not establish a RINEX header/geph FCN provenance gate. Phase129 forbids that inference in its native opt-in path.

phase111_miss_mask.commit_action: swap the retained vector only after per-signal/global conservation

permitted_sources: RINEX observation GLONASS SLOT / FRQ # header FCN for the exact typed satellite
selected time-valid broadcast GLONASS ephemeris geph.frq for the exact typed satellite and existing FGO query time
provenance_policy.header_priority: header FCN is primary when present and must equal the selected geph.frq
provenance_policy.header_absent_rule: selected time-valid geph.frq is the only permitted source
provenance_policy.query_time: existing FGO second-pass transmit/query time; no new iteration or time substitute
provenance_policy.validity: existing valid flag and abs(query_time - toe) <= 1800 seconds
provenance_policy.missing_or_invalid_action: explicit local miss, with reason and side/stage/signal counters
provenance_policy.missing_geph_action: explicit local miss; no header-only certification
provenance_policy.wavelength_action: require finite positive wavelength from certified FCN; otherwise explicit local miss

admission_semantics.base_side: Uncertified GLO base rows contribute no sample to their exact (SatelliteId,SignalType) correction stream. Certified rows continue through the existing Phase126 source-complete residual, smoothing, and interpolation path.
admission_semantics.rover_side: A GLO code row with no exact certified base stream or no finite in-domain correction is removed by the existing Phase111 miss mask. A finite certified correction is subtracted once and retained.
admission_semantics.stage_sharing: GNSS-first and main consume the same post-mask shared factor population; no stage-specific re-inference or fallback.
admission_semantics.non_glonass: Non-GLONASS rows retain existing Phase126/Phase111 semantics and are not filtered by the Phase129 provenance predicate.
admission_semantics.global_boundary: Phase126 A/B/C, station/reference, state, geometry, atmosphere, interval, stream-integrity, finite-data, and graph gates remain route-global fail-closed conditions.
admission_semantics.phase128_gate_override: Only when Phase129 is explicitly on, the route-level all-GLO-FCN-complete predicate is replaced by certified-or-explicit-miss row accounting. Canonical Phase128 field/key/parser checks remain required. Selector-off historical Phase128 behavior is unchanged.

predicates: raw GNSS/IMU/navigation/base inputs and finite retained epochs are nonempty
all required source-complete A/B/C transaction steps pass atomically
at least one finite positive certified/base correction stream remains
at least one finite corrected rover pseudorange factor remains
per-signal and global factor/stream conservation passes
existing C7/D/CCDD/position/velocity alignment and graph gates pass
no unclassified row, partial mutation, duplicate correction, fallback, repair, or extrapolation

certified_glonass_zero.condition: remaining non-GLONASS streams/factors satisfy all existing finite, exact, and graph gates
certified_glonass_zero.meaning: zero certified GLO is an explicit telemetry result, never permission to retain raw GLO rows

minimum_data_and_fail_closed.empty_route: If all rows/streams are removed, no finite source stream exists, or no finite graph code factor remains, fail closed before solver launch.
minimum_data_and_fail_closed.all_glo_only_route: If the route depends only on uncertified GLONASS rows, fail closed before solver launch.
minimum_data_and_fail_closed.minimum_threshold_source: Existing structural gates only; no new accuracy threshold, sigma, LM, or factor-count tuning is introduced.

required_telemetry.conservation_identity: original = retained_corrected + explicit_provenance_miss + missing_stream + out_of_domain + nonfinite
required_telemetry.pre_admission_rows: Rows rejected by invalid raw data or unavailable source state are counted in separate typed pre-admission buckets and never silently omitted from the denominator.
